note: s_frac = apex distance / lap length, 0 at the start/finish line. The TinyPedal widget interpolates it into its own recorded map so no coordinate system is shared between the two code bases. label_offset_m is the driver's own placement in metres from the corner (sim Y up), drawn for display_orientation; the widget uses it before its own placement rule, and falls back to that rule if it would collide.
